あらすじ

The protagonist, Katsuragi Nozomi, is being taken care of by his kind maid, Saionji Hinano, while his busy parents are away on a business trip. His carefree aunt, Igarashi Ayano, also visits often, and both women dote on him. One day, Nozomi watches an anime DVD in his parents’ bedroom and sees his mother in a shocking scene of intimacy with his father, causing him to ejaculate. After this incident, his relationships with Hinano and Ayano start to change, and Nozomi tries to become a better man with their guidance.

あらすじ

Kaede Hinata’s parents win an overseas trip in a lottery in the shopping district. During spring break, he will be home alone with his older sister, Tsubasa, and younger sister, Ran. Both sisters decide to take this opportunity to train the weak protagonist in an effort to teach him how to be a man. He has always been put upon in various ways and has been strained both physically and mentally, but he soon shows some promising changes.

あらすじ

Following the death of his younger brother, Mitsuru’s mother has become cold towards him. He is bullied at school, develops a dark and brooding personality, and lives in the shadow of his father who is perfect at work, athletics, and practically everything else.

When his father also unexpectedly passes away, his life drastically changes. His mother Mayumi has been crying every day since his father’s death, but makes an effort to get closer to her remaining son. The two bridge the gap with some physical contact that had never existed before…

别名

  • ママしぼり^3の事情

あらすじ

The protagonist of this story is the son of the protagonist from the previous work, and he is worried that he too will suffer from the same condition as his father - hyperspermia. One day, he finds an erotic book in his sister’s room, which causes his genitalia to enlarge. Soon, his mother finds out and takes him to the hospital, where he is diagnosed with hyperspermia. The treatment prescribed is to release more sperm. The mother and sister do everything they can to help him, and even the mother of his classmate and a female doctor at the hospital assist him.

Akifumi Chizu’s mornings always began with his sister’s lips.
